title: test_root_endpoint_returns_api_information
description: Verify that the root endpoint returns a welcome message along with API version, status, documentation URL, and description as expected.

title: test_health_check_endpoint_returns_system_status
description: Verify that the /health endpoint returns the current health status, queue size, and any alerts in the system.

title: test_user_signup_with_valid_and_duplicate_email
description: Test the user signup endpoint to ensure new users can register with valid email and password, and that duplicate email registration is rejected with appropriate error.

title: test_user_login_with_valid_and_invalid_credentials
description: Test the user login endpoint to verify that valid credentials return an access token and invalid credentials return an unauthorized error.

title: test_create_project_with_valid_data
description: Verify that a new project can be created successfully when valid title and description are provided by an authenticated user.

title: test_send_message_to_tilotma_agent_and_receive_response
description: Test sending a message to the Tilotma AI agent via the chat send endpoint and verify that a valid AI response is returned including flags for project creation and cost.

title: test_file_upload_single_and_multiple_files
description: Verify that single and multiple file upload endpoints accept files correctly and associate them with the specified project.

title: test_deploy_project_and_check_deployment_status
description: Test the project deployment endpoint to ensure deployment to GCP Cloud Run is initiated and that deployment status can be retrieved correctly.

title: test_approve_reject_and_request_changes_on_checkpoints
description: Verify the checkpoint approval workflow endpoints to approve, reject with feedback, and request changes with required feedback on project checkpoints.

title: test_websocket_connection_for_real_time_project_updates
description: Test establishing a WebSocket connection to receive real-time updates on project status and activities for a given project ID.
